title: Invalid Version/Outdated Client - Solution and Guide

posts.h:
Some players might have experienced the following error messages:

"Invalid Version"
"Outdated Client"

if you encounter this issue, you need to follow this guide:

1. Uninstall Brick-Force
2. Delete your Brick-Force Folder (It won't work, if you don't delete the game folder)
3. Download the latest version from our website: www.brick-force.com (Do not use your old installer!)
4. Download this file, unpack it with Winrar and execute it: Brick-Force Remover from HeadPuster
(Information: This Batch File will remove the Brick Force Entry in the registry. As long as you don't modify the file, everything will work properly.)
5. Download .NET Framework 4.0 and install it: http://www.microsoft.com/en-us/downl....aspx?id=17851
6. Install the game again, using the latest installer from our website
7. Uncheck "Launch Brick-Force" after installation has been finished
8. Start the Game by using the Desktop Shortcut and you should be able to patch the client properly.

If you have further questions, feel free to ask.

Please give me a feedback if you had to use this option, so we know if it solved your problem and if it was easy to use or not.

Thank you.

P.S. Here is a video that shows the whole process:

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=869qbpeOWYI

title: Connection Problems - Port List for Brick-Force

posts.h:
If you ever encountered one of the following errors, you might wanna check your firewall/antivirus/router settings.

For firewall and router, the most common problem are the connections to the game.

Failed to fetch patch server url (Means you can't connect to the patch server, because your computer can't translate the IP of the patcher and your game can't be started)
Can not access to the download server (This is either because there is a problem with your connection to the game or we are having maintenance)
Before you are changing your router, please try this file: Connection Fix for Brick-Force.zip
Within the archive are 2 files. One for US and one for EU.
Please use ONLY the relevant file for the server you are playing on. Otherwise you are messing up your registry and then you have to uninstall Brick-Force first.

If this did not help, please check your firewall/router for the following ports.
tcp 18888
tcp 18889
tcp 18890
tcp 843
tcp 18895:18950
udp 6000:61499

Under normal circumstances, you don't need to do anything but if you are behind a very strict security, you have to add these exceptions to your firewall, in order to play Brick-Force.

If ypou are still unable to play, please contact our technical support here: http://support.infernum.com
